name: Zan
doc: Fujin's Zan (enemy attack 214, c0m119 / c0m136, on a party member): the blade thrown from the caster's bone past the target and back along a path, spinning, a fading trail behind it, dust on the floor under it; at the hit a layout at the target, streaks thrown out, the damage; the caster's weapon hidden meanwhile. Boomerang Sword 304's and Metsu 323's kin. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag322_zan.cpp) run on the program's memory (its main, trails, hit, streaks and dust in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Dust
